Source: Faith and Fire, Derangements

Some characters cannot accept the real world, so they transpose themselves into an illusory one instead. This is something of a catch-all derangement - the scope and degree of the fantasy varies considerably and should be worked out with the Storyteller. The character interacts with the world in an almost normal manner, but her perception of events is skewed by her fantasy.

Trigger/Effect: Something happening to shatter the illusions the character has crafted about herself can cast her into frenzy.
